newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Morgan and Banks buys out NZ unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Morgan and Banks buys out NZ unit.

text.p: Finance personnel agency Morgan and Banks Ltd said on Monday it had purchased the remaining 64.5 percent shareholding in Morgan and Banks New Zealand for NZ$12.1 million.
Morgan and Banks said payment would consist of equity and cash, with settlement in two installments on January 31 and June 30 this year.
The second installment will be performance related.

Morgan and Banks New Zealand was established in 1984 and achieved record revenue of NZ$45 million in the year to June 30, 1996. The New Zealand group employs 230 people in Auckland and Wellington and also has 635 contract and temporary staff.

"The increased investment in Morgan and Banks New Zealand will incorporate a significant and profitable business into the Morgan and Banks group," said Andrew Banks, Morgan and Banks' joint managing director.
Morgan and Banks' shares last traded at A$6.30 on January 31. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
